title: Compose customer architecture snapshot content
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall compose customer architecture snapshot content within its accountable browser contribution to SR-084, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.

why.rationale: MOD-004 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-084 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-004 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-084 criteria 1, 2, 5. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: A minimal supported customer model using its own entity IDs can produce Logical, Process, Development, Physical and Scenario entry points without RigorLoop-specific records, contribution tables or local operational history.
The result identifies selected project, declared profile, input content identity, generator version and generation scope. A Git revision alone does not identify changed working-tree content.
An absent optional view fact remains an explicit absence or limitation rather than making the supported minimal model invalid.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
